idea-plugin.name: Flawd BPMN Editor
idea-plugin.description:
View and edit BPMN 2.0 process diagrams (.bpmn, .bpmn2, *.bpmn20.xml) right in the IDE.
  • Graphical modeler powered by bpmn-js, with a properties panel for IDs, names, conditions and documentation
  • Diagram, split and XML text views; edits in either view stay in sync
  • Diagram edits are regular IDE undo steps
  • Selecting an element in split view jumps to its XML
  • Follows the IDE light/dark theme; export diagrams as SVG
  • File | New | BPMN Diagram to start a new process

The diagram editor is built on bpmn-js by Camunda Services GmbH (bpmn.io).

action.description: Create a new BPMN 2.0 process diagram
